title: Malicious code in pkgreg-buildprobe-16c409218045 (PyPI)
description: The PyPI package pkgreg-buildprobe-16c409218045 contains malicious code that uses fake HTTP-downloaded dependencies to track downloads. It serves no other purpose beyond this tracking behavior. The package versions 0.0.1 and 0.0.2 are affected. This package is categorized as low-harm, likely related to pentesting or research activities, and is associated with dependency confusion techniques.
